finalists.label: Cholesterol Crystal Embolism
finalists.why: It has specific evidence including needle-shaped clefts within the lumen of a blood vessel and severe peripheral arterial disease.

finalists.label: Atherosclerosis
finalists.why: It is supported by the patient's severe peripheral arterial disease and history of percutaneous endovascular stenting of a left popliteal artery aneurysm.

finalists.label: Hypersensitivity Vasculitis
finalists.why: It is indicated by the well-defined purpuric patch and eccrine ducts with cellular dyshesion and necrosis.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of needle-shaped clefts within the lumen of a blood vessel with minimal perivascular inflammation specifically supports Cholesterol Crystal Embolism over other finalists.
